description: Istanbul General Dam Occupancy Rates is a dataset listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by İSKİ. The data set includes daily changes in the occupancy rates of dams in Istanbul. The dataset will be updated at a later date. Coverage: İSKİ. The publisher named on the listing is İSKİ. Its keywords include baraj, doluluk, istanbul, oran, çevre, İSKİ. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2022-03-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
